messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: latency.p95/p99 firing for service=inference-gateway region=eu-west. p95=1.3s (SLO=0.5s), p99=1.8s. Triggered ~3m ago. PagerDuty -> ENG_ONCALL. https://alerts.internal/1753456789

toni: ack — I'm oncall, picking this up.

aya: ack — joining. pulling dashboards now.

marta: seeing a big tail on requests hitting tokenizer-sidecar, CPU steal + queue depth spike :thinking_face:.

kevin: confirm. tokenizer_queue_length x8, worker CPU pinned on node-42. log-shipper DaemonSet on same node is OOMing/restarting frequently. suspect noisy log agent.

toni: good catch. plan: cordon/drain node-42 to remove noisy agent. `kubectl cordon node-42 && kubectl drain node-42 --ignore-daemonsets --force`

aya: while we drain, routing a small percent to fallback model variant `rwd-model-small-q4` for /generate to reduce tokenizer cost. infractl: `infractl route add --service inference-gateway --variant rwd-model-small-q4 --weight 10`

marta: noted — p95 dropped 1.3s -> 0.9s after reroute at ~1753456860, still above SLO. continuing.

kevin: started restart of log-shipper DS on node-42: `kubectl rollout restart ds/log-shipper -n infra`

toni: will escalate to PD if not under SLO in 7m. @lee FYI for handoff in ~30m.

sre-bot: deploybot: node-42 cordon/drain in progress — 3 pods evicted, 2 remaining.

aya: adding temporary KV cache warmup for hot prefixes to reduce tokenizer hits: `tools/cache-warmup --prefixes hotlist.txt --region eu-west`

marta: customer impact: CS flagged 1 enterprise tenant seeing slow autosave and delayed responses; ticket support-12234. Not an outage but user-visible degradation.

kevin: metrics update: tokenization latency per-call decreased after restart, p95 now ~0.65s. p99 still ~1.8s due to a small subset of very large prompts.

toni: can we mitigate for big prompts quickly? aya, can we clamp or chunk them?

aya: deploying short-term gateway param clamp: `gateway.config.rate_limits.prompt_max_tokens=2048` and enabling chunking `gateway.config.chunking.enabled=true`. Rolling to canary now.

sre-bot: config-change: gateway rate_limits + chunking applied to canary (5% traffic).

marta: after chunking, p99 dropped 1.8s -> 0.95s for affected flows. UX should be much better.

toni: closing PD escalation. Leaving thread open for handoff + follow-ups. Summary: root cause likely noisy log-shipper causing CPU steal -> tokenizer queue backlog; mitigations executed: node drain, restart log-shipper DS, reroute 10% to smaller model, cache warmup, prompt chunking.

lee: ack and taking handoff at 1753457209. I'll monitor the next 2 hours and own the post-incident writeup if things stay stable.

aya: thanks — I'll open a quick runbook PR: `docs/runbooks/tokenizer-backpressure.md` with checklist of mitigations.

marta: :thumbsup: filing follow-up ticket to set memory limits and OOM alerts for log-shipper, and to add autoscaling for tokenizer-sidecar.

incident-bot: RESOLVED: alert cleared — latency.p95 back within SLO. https://alerts.internal/1753456789/resolve
